full_judgment: 7. On consultation of the Chassis Book the vehicle was found to have been manufactured in the year 1989-90 which was more than 5 years old and the same is an offence under Section 3 (1) of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950 read with Section 16 of the Customs Act, 1969 and punishable under Section 156 (1).
